objective: Remove the redundant own-profile name capsule and Spot title banner, then make active timed Spot check-ins control board access while board posts persist until deleted and expired check-ins generate a notification.
userOutcome: Members see compact profile and Spot headers, check into a Spot for a chosen duration, access its board only during that check-in, keep board posts until deletion, and receive notice when access ends.
audience: Authenticated cruush members using profiles and Spots on Android mobile and desktop.
successCriteria: The own-profile top overlay keeps Back, Edit Profile, and the global bug button but does not repeat the member name.
The Spot detail page removes the large repeated title banner while retaining Back and the global bug button.
A member without an active check-in cannot read or write a Spot board and sees the timed check-in control instead.
A member with an active check-in can read and write the Spot board until the selected check-in duration ends.
Board posts have no expiry and remain owner-deletable.
When a check-in expires, board access ends and the member receives an app and push notification through existing notification preferences.
mustPreserve: Preserve the profile image, profile details, Edit Profile control, Back control, and global bug button.
Preserve the approved cruush vector map style and all map behavior.
Preserve Spot identity details, ratings, reports, Popular times, Who's Here, board encryption, moderation, deletion, and pagination.
Preserve all unrelated user work and existing assets.
nonGoals: No map, Crowd Mode, feed, Ghost Mode, profile-content, or unrelated Spot redesign.
No test creation or execution, build, preview, or rendered verification.
No server restart, migration execution, push, deployment, changelog, or email work.

assumptions.statement: The redundant profile name means only the top overlay name capsule shown in the supplied own-profile screenshot.
assumptions.impact: The name remains in the profile content beside the age.

assumptions.statement: The unnecessary Spot banner means the repeated sticky title header shown in the supplied Spot screenshot.
assumptions.impact: The Spot identity remains in the page content while Back remains independently available.

Stop if board access cannot be separated from unrelated Spot or map behavior.
